elbow_flex.source: ACE Seated Chest Press: press until the elbows are fully extended but not locked (15 degrees); during the return, the elbows flex back toward the starting bent position at the chest (illustrative 90 degrees, matching a loaded machine start)

torso_lean.source: ACE Seated Chest Press: the shoulder blades stay in contact with the backrest and should not round or move forward off it

muscles.peakSource: Chest press mistake guides (Breaking Muscle, Gravitus): "press up through the upper chest, not with the shoulders," and keep the shoulders down and back, so chest effort is highest approaching full extension, not from a shoulder shrug

mistake.name: Round and lock

tells.text: The shoulder blades round forward off the backrest to finish the press.
The elbows slam all the way to a hard lockout instead of stopping just short.

mistake.source: ACE Seated Chest Press: a very frequent mistake is pressing until the shoulder blades round forward and move off the backrest; chest press mistake guides (Breaking Muscle, Gravitus): avoid locking the elbows out completely, which loses constant tension
